'''Vhork Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadron of the [[Hapan Royal Navy]]. Named after the [[vhork]], a giant Daruvvian hawk, it was considered the best squadron in the Hapan Navy.<ref name="apocalypse" />

In [[44 ABY]], they participated in the [[Evacuation of Ossus (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|evacuation]] of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Youngling/Legends|Younglings]] from their [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].<ref name="apocalypse" />
